mutations.why: word-set substitution: add one extra word to ALL_PREFIXES inside the not_words(...) call, removing `foo` from arm C's complement so a path-basename `foo` prefix stops matching
noplus narrowing: drop the optional `+` from the assignment operator, so an append-assignment `A+=1` prefix stops matching arm A
assignment-bound narrowing (N=16): bound arm A's value run `_seg*` to `_seg{0,16}`, so a >16-char assignment value drops out of the language
redirect-bound narrowing (N=16): bound arm B's glued-redirect run `_seg+` to `_seg{1,16}`, so a >16-char glued redirect target drops out of the language
path-bound narrowing (N=16): bound arm C's path run `nonspace*/` to `nonspace{0,16}/`, so a >16-char path segment before the basename drops out of the language
_asg drops lowercase names; a lowercase VAR= no longer opens a command position (both substrates fail open on the install)
_asg drops digits in the name tail; a name with a digit (PERL5OPT) is no longer an assignment
_asg allows only single-char names; any multi-char name (FOO=1) is no longer an assignment
_red drops '<'; a '<' input redirect no longer opens a command position
_red allows at most one fd digit; a two-digit fd (10>) no longer matches the glued redirect arm
_seg drops '='; an '=' in an assignment value stops the _asg _seg* arm before its trailing space
